biggest_catch: In-branch opening only: the official page's call to action is "Open In Branch" and deal trackers (Doctor of Credit, updated 9/12/26) report the offer is branch-only, valid until 10/31/26. You must complete BOTH $1,000+ in direct deposits within 60 days AND 20 debit card point-of-sale transactions in the same period - either half alone earns nothing.
catches: Account must be opened in a WesBanco Banking Center; online openings do not qualify per the official page's branch-only call to action.
Supply promo code WBCHECKING at account opening.

Both requirements must be met in the same 60-day window: (1) direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 within 60 days of opening, AND (2) 20 debit card point-of-sale transactions with the WesBanco VISA debit card in the same period.
Valid until 10/31/2026 per deal-tracker reporting of the current campaign (official page carries no end date).
Not available to customers with a current checking account (deal-tracker fine print).
Bonus will not be paid if the account is closed or in overdraft when it is credited (deal-tracker fine print).
Businesses and WesBanco employees are not eligible (deal-tracker fine print).

steps: Visit a WesBanco Banking Center and open a new WesBanco One Account, supplying promo code WBCHECKING at opening.
Receive direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 within 60 days of account opening.
Complete 20 debit card point-of-sale transactions with your WesBanco VISA debit card in the same 60-day period.
Bonus is credited once both qualifying activities have posted and the account remains open and in good standing.
timing: Direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 and 20 debit card point-of-sale transactions must all occur within 60 days of account opening. Campaign reported valid through 10/31/2026; official page does not publish a payout date.
